purpose: Publication-safe historical evidence index; not trading certification.
publication_stage: Collaborative source alpha; milestone completion not asserted.
public_issue_provenance: Existing repository/issues supplied by parent after remote readback verification; no remote access performed by this audit.

source_snapshot.observation: Public source derives from baseline with publication safety-hold edits; exact snapshot hash only. Sibling compile/fake evidence must be separately pinned after final edits.

status_definitions.UNTESTED: No matching execution evidence for the named exact artifact/environment.
status_definitions.KNOWN_PRODUCT_DEFECT: Failed safety invariant on a pinned product implementation; not necessarily reproduced at a provider.
status_definitions.HARNESS_ORACLE_POLICY_MISMATCH: Failure retained but attribution depends on harness validity, representation or an unadopted contract.
status_definitions.SCOPED_FIX_NOT_INTEGRATED: Named candidate passes named scope; public source has not absorbed this repair.
status_definitions.PURE_SPEC_ONLY: Validator/model tests only; no production-engine dispatch acceptance.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Provider or external acceptance not established.

count_policy: Counts are scoped invocations/checks, may overlap or repeat; do not sum into unique coverage or use assertions/pins/snapshots as coverage percentage.
privacy_policy: No personal Windows paths, private account names, raw logs, transcripts, credentials, scraped vendor HTML or proprietary binaries distributed. Origin labels refer to local historical files, not public URLs.
